spans.s: a praiser, panegyrist, celebrator, ib.; AV.
N. of a Ṛṣi (who was cast into a well by the Asuras and lay there for ten nights and nine days until rescued by the Aśvins; he is the supposed author of RV. viii, 97, having the patr. काश्यप), RV.
रेभ—सूनु m. du. two sons of Rebha, authors of RV. ix, 99; 100.
Nom. P. ˚यति, to shine, beam, Āpast.
or रेभि˚लक, m. N. of a man, Mṛcch.
